summary: The host discusses a new initiative involving 12 teams receiving seed funding and mentorship, noting its similarity to Spotify's past model and highlighting that Jenna Weiss-Berman of Pineapple Street Media serves as a co-chair on the advisory committee alongside Amit Dashi. The speaker promotes their upcoming appearance at the Sound Education conference in Boston and encourages listeners to continue using the #PodsInColor hashtag on social media. The segment concludes with an introduction to an interview with Favy Fav, who shares that he goes by his legal name Favela or his internet nickname Favy Fav.
